name: Melanie
headline: Turn Marriott’s booking data into stays that come back.
saw: Across a hotel group, the booking path usually presents every guest with the same rates, packages and stay offers, whether they are loyal members, one-time travellers or guests about to lapse.

Stay history, rate purchases, cancellations, room upgrades and the moment a guest stops booking are the strongest signals you own for the next offer and the next save. Today that signal sits in revenue analytics, not in the message the guest receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are usually built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to lapse this week gets the same package offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per guest, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per guest from booking pace, cancellations and stay gaps, then the right offer, channel and moment for each guest, tested continuously across your hotels.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next stay that fits
cases.text: Next best offer per guest from stay history and booking pattern: a suite upgrade, a dining add-on or a longer stay, sent in the channel the guest answers. No more blanket upgrade mails.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep every guest booking again
cases.text: Keep every guest engaged between stays with personal property, dining and experience nudges in email and push, orchestrated so each guest has a reason to book again.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
